contentList.content: Camp Buffs: Mod Buffs Ring
Addon ring for CampBuffs. Grants DnD 5.5e Artificer Infusions and Mystra's Spells buffs with hotbar toggles.
Cast Modded Camp Buffs
Apply all enabled DnD 5.5e and Mystra camp buffs to all party members in a 30m radius.
Remove Modded Camp Buffs
Remove all applied DnD 5.5e and Mystra camp buffs from party members in a 30m radius.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Defense (+1 AC)
Include Artificer Enhanced Defense (+1 AC) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Defense (+2 AC)
Include Artificer Enhanced Defense (+2 AC) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Weapon (+1)
Include Artificer Enhanced Weapon (+1 Attack and Damage) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Weapon (+2)
Include Artificer Enhanced Weapon (+2 Attack and Damage) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Returning Weapon
Include Artificer Returning Weapon (+1 attack/damage, thrown weapons return to hand) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Repeating Shot
Include Artificer Repeating Shot (+1 ranged attack/damage, magical repeating ammo) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Arcane Focus (+1)
Include Artificer Enhanced Arcane Focus (+1 Spell Attack & Spell Save DC) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Enhanced Arcane Focus (+2)
Include Artificer Enhanced Arcane Focus (+2 Spell Attack & Spell Save DC) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Bag of Holding
Include Artificer Bag of Holding (12.5x carrying capacity multiplier) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Armor of Magical Strength
Include Artificer Armor of Magical Strength (+2 Strength checks/saves, immunity to prone/knockdown) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Boots of the Winding Path
Include Artificer Boots of the Winding Path (+3m movement speed, Misty Step teleport) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Repulsion Shield
Include Artificer Repulsion Shield (+1 AC, +1 Saves) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Ceremony - Coming of Age
Include Mystra's Ceremony: Coming of Age (+1d4 to ability & skill checks) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Water Walk
Include Mystra's Water Walk (immunity to difficult terrain, grease, acid, lava) when casting Camp Buffs.
Mod Buff: Gift of Alacrity
Include Mystra's Gift of Alacrity (+2 and +1d8 Initiative bonus) when casting Camp Buffs.
